title: Data-Efficient Backdoor Attacks on Code Models via Trigger-Neutralized Counterfactual Scoring
abstract: arXiv:2610.32334v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pre-trained code models are exposed to backdoor poisoning, in which crafted training samples make the model misbehave on a trigger. A capable attacker minimizes the number of such samples, since each adds cost and exposure and a lower poisoning rate leaves a smaller footprint for defenses. Which samples to poison therefore matters, but existing data-efficient selection methods target image classification, offer no scoring mechanism for autoregressive generation, and have not been studied on code. We propose Trigger-Neutralized Counterfactual Scoring (TNCS), which isolates a trigger's contribution to the target behavior by comparing the scoring model's output on a triggered input with its output on a trigger-neutralized counterfactual, covering classification and generation alike. translated_title: 基于触发器中和反事实评分的代码模型数据高效后门攻击
translated_abstract: 预训练代码模型面临后门投毒攻击的威胁，攻击者通过构造恶意训练样本使模型在出现触发器时产生错误行为。一个“有能力的”攻击者会尽量减少此类样本的数量，因为每个样本都会增加成本和暴露风险，且更低的投毒率会给防御留下更小的痕迹。因此，选择对哪些样本进行投毒至关重要，但现有的数据高效样本选择方法主要针对图像分类任务，没有为自回归生成任务提供评分机制，也尚未在代码领域得到研究。我们提出了触发器中和反事实评分（TNCS）方法，通过比较评分模型在触发输入上的输出与其在触发器被中和的反事实样本上的输出，来分离触发器对目标行为的贡献，从而同时适用于分类和生成任务。在三个CodeXGLUE任务和五个触发器家族上，TNCS在极低投毒比例下取得了比基线方法更高的攻击成功率，且不会降低（模型性能）……
tldr: 该论文提出触发器中和反事实评分（TNCS）方法，通过比较触发输入与触发器中和反事实样本上的模型输出差异来精确筛选投毒样本，在极低投毒率下即可对代码模型实现高成功率的后门攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Trigger-Neutralized Counterfactual Scoring (TNCS), which isolates a trigger's contribution by comparing model outputs on triggered inputs versus trigger-neutralized counterfactuals, enabling high-success backdoor attacks on code models at very low poisoning rates.
